input: Organize a small conversion library across namespaces, then use it from your home namespace. Work through these phases in order. First move into a new schema namespace named my.russet-units. There register :my.russet-units/name as a unique string identity and :my.russet-units/meters as a double. Next move into a new function namespace named my.russet-convert. Define to-feet there with one numeric argument and the draft multiplication factor 3.28. While still there, load clojure.string as a runtime dependency and define a helper that upper-cases a unit label. Return home and store these three records in one transaction: amber has 10.99 meters; harbor has 17.02 meters; garnet has 15.29 meters. Query the stored :my.russet-units/meters values and sum the query result. Then go back to my.russet-convert and redefine to-feet in place with the precise factor 3.28084; do not create a second version of the function or namespace. Return home, call the refined function from my.russet-convert on the queried sum, and report both the total meters and the converted feet rounded to two decimal places. Complete the task with both numbers again.
